name: guessit-js
description: Parse movie and TV filenames: title, year, season, episode, codecs, languages, release group.
long_description: Extracts metadata from movie and TV episode filenames and release names: title, year, season, episode, episode title, resolution, video and audio codec, source, streaming service, language, subtitle language, release group, container and more (56 properties). Same JSON as Python guessit, parses many real-world names better. Runs locally, offline, no API key, no data leaves your machine.

tools.name: guessit
tools.description: Parse one movie or TV episode filename or release name

tools.name: guessit_batch
tools.description: Parse many filenames in one call

tools.description: List every property guessit can return with its possible values
